current_stage.name: D122: Republish complete -- western Japan z13+ and Tsushima/Goto z8-11 gaps confirmed resolved live
current_stage.description: The full repair-and-republish cycle (D115-D122) is done. Root causes fixed: (1) Tsushima/Goto z8-11 gap -- two missing ocean-only aggregation outputs were blocking a chained downsampling work item (D115). (2) A coastal boundary-blur bug in aggregation_merge.py that could ship hard elevation cliffs at block seams (D116). (3) The published archive was silently missing ALL z13+ tiles across western Japan (Kyushu, Okinawa, Shikoku, Chugoku) since a 2026-09-02 ENOSPC-interrupted merge silently republished with only 14 of 23 regional bundles (D117) -- a merge-completeness gate was added to prevent recurrence. Rebuilt the full archive (bundle -> merge -> cluster -> z0-7 overview splice), verified locally (Fable, D118), then published to stars via LAN rsync (D122) -- live spot-checks of the previously-broken coordinates now return correct data matching the local verification exactly. Remaining known-but-non-blocking items (all carried into the 1.5-go plan): 949/8223 downsampling items are stale relative to their inputs (D119, invisible in rendering), and stars' 100Mbps network link (unexplained, should be gigabit) made the ~314GB republish take ~7h48m.
